summary: Classover Holdings, Inc. filed an 8-K to disclose entry into an at-the-market (ATM) sales agreement with Chardan Capital Markets LLC on May 14, 2026. The agreement allows the company to sell up to $9.115 million of its Class B common stock from time to time through the agent. The agent receives a 3% commission and certain expense reimbursements. This is a routine equity shelf distribution facility, not a transformational special situation. No specific pricing, premium, or definitive deal terms are stated beyond the maximum aggregate amount.
